TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the massive pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: The transaction reads pricingRuleRequest and invokes ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules(pricingRuleRequest). The library validates that the request and its details exist, that at least two ACT details are present, that ACT detail IDs are not duplicated, that every detail has entityType and id, that effectiveDate.startDate and effectiveDate.endDate define a valid date range, that no duplicate pricing rule conflict exists, and that each detail ID can be resolved to a value. 2. Decisions and branches: If any reachable validation or persistence step throws PricingRuleException, the library adds the advice with the exception code and description and returns an empty list. Otherwise it builds one pricing rule per ACT detail by copying the common request data and keeping the current ACT detail in each generated rule. 3. Libraries and methods invoked: The transaction obtains library ABKOR001 through getServiceLibrary(...) and calls executePostMassivePricingRules(...). Inside that flow, the library resolves the audit user from the request header, obtains IDs for the massive custom attribute batch and for each pricing rule, inserts the massive custom attribute marker, adds a CUS detail with value MASIVA to each generated rule, persists every pricing rule and its details, and returns the created list. 4. Errors and follow-up actions: After the library call, the transaction assigns severity EWR when the advice list is not empty. Reachable business advices in this flow are ABKO10010420, ABKO10010421, ABKO10010422, ABKO10000404, ABKO10010401, ABKO10010402, ABKO10010415, ABKO10010004, and ABKO00000010. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: The transaction always sets pricingRulesResponse with the returned list; on successful creation it contains the generated pricing rules, and when an advice is raised it is set to an empty list.

TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the massive pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: The transaction reads pricingRuleRequest and sends it to ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules. The library rejects requests with null details, fewer than two ACT details, duplicated ACT ids, invalid details, endDate before startDate, duplicated pricing rules, overlapping variable payment methods, or detail ids that cannot be resolved. 2. Decisions and branches: The library separates ACT details from common details, creates one pricing rule per ACT detail, enriches detail values, and validates each generated rule before any insert is executed. If any validation or persistence step throws a PricingRuleException, the library adds the advice and returns an empty list. 3. Libraries and methods invoked: The transaction obtains ABKOR001 through getServiceLibrary(ABKOR001.class) and invokes executePostMassivePricingRules(pricingRuleRequest). Inside that method, the flow validates the massive request, builds the per-activity rules, resolves the audit user from the request header, obtains ids for the custom attribute batch and the pricing rules, inserts the audit records, creates the massive custom attribute, persists each pricing rule, and persists its details. 4. Errors and follow-up actions: When the returned advice list is not empty, the transaction sets Severity.EWR. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: The transaction always assigns pricingRulesResponse with the list returned by the library, which contains the created pricing rules on success and an empty list when a PricingRuleException was converted into advice.
